$comment: Settings for dsh-plugin-git-commit-push. This copy is the TEMPLATE that ships with the package. To change settings, put your own file at <DSH_HOME>/git-commit-push.config.json (default: ~/.dsh/git-commit-push.config.json): it wins over this one, and it survives reinstalling or updating the package. A source checkout may edit this file directly instead. The next tool call picks changes up — no DSH restart. Omitted keys keep the built-in defaults; a malformed file is reported in the result card rather than ignored.
